'''Hardweave boots''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] [[Boot/Legends|footwear]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from several different interwoven materials which were a range of [[brown]]s in [[Color/Legends|color]].
